reports.title: Lake Allatoona fishing report
reports.text:
Anglers’ successful crappie catch
Bass (courtesy of Ken Sturdivant, Southern Fishing ):
Bass fishing is good. Fish are deep to 20 feet deep and any main lake point can be a hot spot. The trick is to fish them all and break out the good ones and work them with several baits. There are a few small fish a little shallower, but they strike baits so lightly. Try the Zoom finesse worm in natural blue or Limeade. With all the deep fish, there is little to no schooling, and we can blame almost anything but its turnover. All the deep fish start at the 25-foot range. Find the right hole, and it is not clear what makes a hole right other than depth. Drop shot rigs with small hooks and small…

reports.title: Lake Hartwell fishing report
reports.text:
Bass (courtesy of Guide Lane Clark, (864)-254-8614; report via SCDNR Freshwater Fishing Trends ):
Bass (courtesy of Ken Sturdivant, Southern Fishing ):
Bass fishing is fair. There is a good topwater bite in the shallows, but these are all small fish. Casting to the bank is not where the fish are until midday. Better fish are at 15 feet on average. Chug Bugs, Whoppler Ploppers, and jerkbaits at daylight, then Ned rigs and Shakey heads on points and in small cuts close by at 15 feet. This is mostly Spotted Bass, so scale down. reports.title: Lake Lanier fishing report
reports.text:
Bass (courtesy of Phil Johnson, (770) 366-8845 or pjohnson15@hotmail.com; report via Southern Fishing ):
Dashawn Johnson on Lake Lanier catching Largemouth Bass and Spotted Bass.
Bass fishing on Lake Lanier is good. The lake is currently a little over a foot below full pool, and the water temperature is running in the low seventies. Overall, the lake is clear. The fall patterns are setting up, and the bass are feeding up for the winter, but it is still somewhat up and down on catching them. Wind and bait have been the key factors over the last week. Finding the shad over the humps, flats, and long points has been important in finding the bass. The schooling activity has picked up, but it is…

reports.title: Lake Weiss fishing report
reports.text:
Bass (courtesy of Ken Sturdivant, Southern Fishing ):
Bass are starting to move shallow on secondary points and in the backs of the coves following the shad movement. Spotted Bass are being caught on the old river channel ledges in 4 to 8 feet of water.

reports.title: West Point Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Bass (courtesy of Ken Sturdivant, Southern Fishing ):
Bass fishing is good. Shad are headed for the creeks, and it’s about time for the bass to follow along in big numbers. The best bite through late week was up the river on the crankbaits. Find the fish around the shad. Once the bass get into the creeks in full force, it’ll be a good opportunity for crankbaits and spinnerbaits. Rat L Traps and Rapala Shad Raps should be good patterns. Hit the banks, throwing at any piece of wood. Make accurate casts to maximize the chances for a hookup. Buzz baits in the morning will draw some strikes also. Fish are schooling like crazy in the shallows just before sunset. There are mostly hybrids and white…

reports.title: Chattahoochee And Flint River fishing report
reports.text: Water temperatures in the river are starting to come down since we have had some cool nights, so bass fishing should begin to pick up. Fly fishing on the Flint River targeting shoal bass is a lot of fun.

reports.title: Lake Seminole fishing report
reports.text: According to Ken Sturdivant at southernfishing.com, bass fishing is good. It has very sharp hooks and a sound that gets the attention of the big bass. It will get the big bass out of the grass.

reports.title: Big Lazer Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text:
Region 5 Staff’s Bass catch
Largemouth Bass fishing is fair right now. When targeting bass, try shad as well as other fish-lookalike baits at a variety of depths. As the water cools, try pitching crawfish and plastic worms in deeper waters. In cooler waters, try slowing down your plastic baits to increase chances for bites. Bream fishing is generally good this time of year, and that trend should continue with the cooler water temperatures. Woody structures in shallower water all around the lake are good target areas. Live bait such as crickets and worms are extremely productive. The water is still warm enough that catfish are biting fairly well. Channel catfish are located throughout most…

reports.title: Saving Fawns and catching crappie
reports.text: This confused fawn was in the middle of the Savannah River in Clarks Hill yesterday morning swimming in circles. I used my boat to kinda steer her to the bank and after about 3 attempts she finally figured it out. Oh yeah, also caught a good mess of crappie while I was there.

reports.title: Night time bass fishing
reports.text: Who else does it I haven’t till lately. We been going down to the pond lately right at dark fish for around a hour. The big ones seems to be biting good at this time and a couple that snap the 6lb line.We get in our little rocky boat and try not to get hung on the trees limbs.It tricky unhooking in poor light.
